palette: deep walnut wood field, silk-linen paper slips, persimmon orange, moss green, ink sepia, plum red, aged brass
typography: ledger headings on walnut rail tabs, persimmon verdicts and brass condition labels
composition: ownership gates splitting personal and common lanes, a house-and-fruit sorter with growth arrows, a debt gate feeding gift lanes, twin divorce paths with a cooling clock, and an aftermath bench with custody, division and damages rows
surface: silk-linen slips on a walnut wood field with brass corner guards
motion: property slips sort through ownership gates, fruit arrows grow from the principal, debt chips pass the signature gate into gift lanes, the cooling clock drains two 30-day chambers and divorce consequences settle onto the bench
transition: the walnut field, brass guards and paper slip stock persist while gates, sorters, paths and benches are re-dressed between scenes
